trigger: EVIDENCE_TOO_LARGE or MemoryError when loading large factory Casefile JSON into memory
root_cause: Eager JSON parsing of high-volume bulk exclusion arrays (>350KB) overflows memory and agent response context budgets.
verified_remedy: Stream SHA-256 byte digest (_integrity) against trial ledger hash without decoding full JSON; inspect small stage receipts (stage1.json, etc.) for per-stage status.
limitations: Cryptographic hash match proves uncorrupted storage only; does not revalidate numerical statistics.
